name: Liquid Chrome
description: A living sculpture in a white gallery turns to mirror chrome and melts into a rippling pool.

wardrobe.man: a sleek black tailored suit over a black shirt
wardrobe.woman: a sleek floor-length black satin evening dress with thin straps

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands upright and still in the exact center of a vast white minimalist art gallery, like an exhibit, wearing {wardrobe}, arms relaxed at the sides, chin slightly raised. The floor is polished white marble that mirrors {them}, the walls are bare white, and a tall window on the left lets in soft diffused daylight. Wide symmetrical shot from a low camera close to the floor, the full body in the center filling about half of the frame height, a wide expanse of reflective marble in the foreground. Clean high-key editorial fashion photography, cool neutral whites, soft shadows. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, bare white walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands perfectly still in the gallery like a living sculpture, holding the pose with quiet pride, chin raised, eyes fixed on a point just past the camera, one slow calm blink. Starting at the fingertips, {their} skin, hair and clothes turn into flawless mirror-bright liquid chrome that spreads up the arms and over the whole body in two seconds, reflecting the white gallery and the window. Then the chrome figure melts from the top down like liquid mercury, flowing down in heavy glossy waves and pooling on the marble, and the pool of liquid metal runs across the white floor toward the camera in shining rippling streams, until only a wide mirror-like puddle of chrome remains, reflecting the gallery and still rippling gently. The liquid metal has real weight, surface tension and perfect reflections. The camera stays low near the floor and pushes in very slowly. Sound: a crystalline metallic shimmer as the chrome spreads, then a deep liquid pour, heavy metallic drips and a soft wash of liquid across marble in a quiet echoing gallery. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, liquid metal simulation, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame ALREADY holds still. Immediately, starting at the fingertips, {their} skin, hair and clothes turn into flawless mirror-bright liquid chrome that spreads over the whole body in under two seconds, reflecting everything around {them}. Then the chrome figure melts from the top down like liquid mercury, flowing down in heavy glossy waves, and the liquid metal pools on the ground and runs outward in shining rippling streams until only a wide mirror-like puddle remains, still rippling gently. The liquid metal has real weight, surface tension and perfect reflections. The camera keeps the same framing and pushes in very slowly. Sound: a crystalline metallic shimmer, a deep liquid pour, heavy metallic drips and a soft wash of liquid. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, liquid metal simulation, sharp detail, stable picture.
